We need to propose retrosynthesis route with 3 reactions for target SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to produce JSON with nested reactions. Need to find appropriate templates for each step: likely disconnections:

Target has sulfonamide linking a tolyl sulfonyl to phenyl ring with a side chain: an α,β-unsaturated amide attached to an aniline.

We can think retrosynthetic steps:

1. Disconnection of amide bond: break C(=O)-N linking the unsaturated carbonyl to aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). So precursor: α,β-unsaturated acid (C= C- C(=O)H?) Actually the forward reaction: carboxylic acid + amine -> amide via coupling. So retrosynthesis: break amide to give carboxylic acid (the α,β-unsaturated acid) and aniline (c3ccccc3N). So step1: amide formation.

2. Disconnection of sulfonamide: break S-N bond to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid?) and aniline (the tolyl amine). The forward reaction: sulfonamide formation from amine + sulfonyl chloride. So retrosynthesis: break sulfonamide to give sulfonyl chloride (or sulfonic acid) and aniline (the tolyl amine). So step2: sulfonamide formation.

3. Disconnection of α,β-unsaturated acid formation via Doebner modification: break the C=C double bond and carboxyl group to give aromatic aldehyde (maybe p-? Actually the side chain is attached to phenyl ring (c2ccc(... )cc2). The unsaturated acid attached to that phenyl via the double bond: /C=C/C(=O)N... So the α,β-unsaturated acid derived from aromatic aldehyde (the phenyl ring with aldehyde) + malonic acid. So retrosynthesis: break the C=C and carboxyl to give aromatic aldehyde (c2ccc(CHO)cc2) and malonic acid (HOOC-CH2-COOH). So step3: Doebner modification.

Thus we need templates for each: amide formation (carboxylic acid + amine -> amide). sulfonamide formation (amine + sulfonyl chloride -> sulfonamide). Doebner modification (aryl aldehyde + malonic acid -> α,β-unsaturated acid). Need template IDs. We can search.

First, get available functional groups to know correct names.
